desc: Ideate approaches and select lazy anti-diagonal DP as primary.
Build diagonal metadata and flat grid access.
Implement recompute_F and recompute_G for one diagonal.
Process queries: move, recompute invariant diagonal, compute coefficient, update answer and cell F/G.
Handle boundaries, zero values, modulo, and performance optimizations.
Run sample tests and fix failures; if too slow, switch to column-wise lazy DP fallback.
